If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.67–0.33 and forecast is flat, apply 0.5–1.5% upward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days) if true outcome exceeds forecast by >1.5%.  
If sentiment is 0.67 and forecast is rising, cap upward slope at 0.8% per day for early horizon to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is 0.33 and forecast is falling, add 0.5–1.0% downward bias for mid horizon if true outcome is consistently below forecast.  
If sentiment is 0.67 and forecast is flat, apply 0.5% upward bias for late horizon if true outcome is >1.2% above forecast.
